summary:
In this episode, we sit down with Sarah Jenkins, a Senior Software Engineer at TechScale, to discuss the rising popularity of Rust in the world of distributed systems. We explore why many organizations are migrating their performance-critical services from Go and Java to Rust.

Sarah breaks down the concept of 'fearless concurrency' and how Rust's ownership model prevents common pitfalls in large-scale backend architectures. We also touch upon the future of WebAssembly and its role in serverless computing.
